home.description: Load a new folder or a previously opened one to start labeling

oldWorkspace.title: Old workspace detected!
oldWorkspace.description: It looks like you were previously working on an old version of this app. You can automatically migrate the data and keep working where you left off; or you can open a new folder.

enter.description: Saves the label and advances to the next image.

right.description: Skips to the next image without saving the current label.

left.description: Goes back to the previous image without saving the current label.
